See mortality.

"Plan's Benefit Formula" is "See Pension Benefit Formula." Both in 715-30. Separately, slug benefit-formula carries two texts: a 715-30 pointer and a 715-60 substantive definition ("The basis for determining benefits ... under a postretirement benefit plan").
Synonym pointer.

Detector pairing with Probable Reserves (930-10) is a label artifact. But "Probable" is a FASB-acknowledged homonym: status tables label "Probable (2nd def.)" (205-20, 310-40, 605-985, 606-10), and 410-20-25-2/-3 state that probable in the CON 6 liability definition "is used with its usual general meaning, rather than in a specific accounting or technical sense (such as that in paragraph 450-20-25-1)". The crawl collapses both into one slug and text ("The future event or events are likely to occur.").
Headword ProbableReserves (930-10), linked from 255-10 and 805-930.
